description: Add, multiply, invert and transpose 2x2 and 3x3 matrices.

faqs.a: By the adjugate-over-determinant formula. If the determinant is zero the matrix is singular (has no inverse) and the tool reports that instead of producing garbage.
No. This tool handles 2×2 and 3×3 matrices; larger sizes would need a general elimination algorithm this page does not include.
faqs.q: Does it work for 4x4 or larger?

faqs.a: Yes — multiplication uses the standard row-times-column dot products, not element-wise multiplication.

howto: Type the values of matrices A and B.
Press an operation: A+B, A−B, AxB, det, inverse or transpose.
Results appear as a grid below, or an error if the operation is impossible.
